human-athlete-male.title: Athlete (male)
human-athlete-male.description: A realistic male athlete: MakeHuman body shaped for sprinting, 4 skin tones, 3 hairstyles, eyes, eyebrows and eyelashes, a paintable kit (singlet, shorts and spikes), five body morphs and a 66-bone rig with motion-captured run, sprint, idle, standing start and fall, and sword motion: a guard, three cuts, a lunge, a hit and a death.
human-athlete-male.derived: Body shaped with MakeHuman targets; rig reduced from 163 to 66 bones; running motion retargeted from CMU captures (the sprint clip amplifies the captured run); the street fight (a boxer's guard and footwork, jab, cross, hook) and street life (casual, cool, heavyset and women's walks, walking backwards, a jog, shifting weight, arguing, a shrug, a wave) retargeted from CMU captures; sword motion, hits, a roll, getting up, a phone call, folded arms, talking, dancing, sitting and picking something up retargeted from Quaternius's Universal Animation Library; freeflow punches, a kick, a rising uppercut, a leaping kick, a back flip, a side flip, a launcher, air blows, a slam and a finisher retargeted from Spiderbench's hero rig (the clips only).

human-athlete-female.title: Athlete (female)
human-athlete-female.description: A realistic female athlete: MakeHuman body shaped for sprinting, 3 skin tones, 3 hairstyles, eyes, eyebrows and eyelashes, a paintable kit (crop top, shorts and spikes), five body morphs and a 66-bone rig with motion-captured run, sprint, idle, standing start and fall, and sword motion: a guard, three cuts, a lunge, a hit and a death.
human-athlete-female.derived: Body shaped with MakeHuman targets; rig reduced from 163 to 66 bones; running motion retargeted from CMU captures (the sprint clip amplifies the captured run); the street fight (a boxer's guard and footwork, jab, cross, hook) and street life (casual, cool, heavyset and women's walks, walking backwards, a jog, shifting weight, arguing, a shrug, a wave) retargeted from CMU captures; sword motion, hits, a roll, getting up, a phone call, folded arms, talking, dancing, sitting and picking something up retargeted from Quaternius's Universal Animation Library; freeflow punches, a kick, a rising uppercut, a leaping kick, a back flip, a side flip, a launcher, air blows, a slam and a finisher retargeted from Spiderbench's hero rig (the clips only).

city-midtown.title: City district
city-midtown.description: Asphalt, sidewalks, curbs, road markings, facades (16 wall layers with their normals and weathering), roofs, building interiors seen through the windows, grass and leaves, the street furniture and rooftop clutter, and the life on the streets: 13 kinds of car, van, truck and bus at three levels of detail, and 24 kinds of pedestrian (and their dogs) with 27 baked animations. What the city map builds its streets and blocks from.
city-midtown.derived: Recompressed for the web (colour to WebP, the layer atlases to JPEG, normals to 1024 px). The shop-sign atlas is GameMog’s own, drawn in the original’s layout with invented names. On the vehicle atlas the three taxi-topper ads, the taxi badge and the bus names are repainted with GameMog’s own. Car and people geometry rounded to well under a millimetre and gzipped.

sfx-impacts.title: Impact sounds
sfx-impacts.description: Recorded impacts for the fight, 38 sounds in 11 families (punch, heavy, body, fall, wood, staff, metal, blade, slam, boom, clatter): punches, kicks, weapons by material, falls, a slam. The runtime plays them itself in open worlds; no world lists them.
sfx-impacts.derived: Decoded from Ogg Vorbis, made mono (the pack is dual-mono), DC blocked, the silence before each hit and its tail under -50 dB cut, brought to the same peak, joined into one sprite and encoded as AAC.
